dedupe_keys.name: alea sismicite a la commune sur auvergne rhone alpes en 2010

description: Aléa sismicité à la commune sur Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes en 2010 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.datara.gouv.fr. The earthquake plan launched in 2005 presented a new map of the seismic hazard. Its classification varies by commune from the low to medium value for the municipalities of the defence zone. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Hazard seismicity in the commune on Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes in 2010" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Gestion de crise, PacInno. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
